      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0

      "feature_family": "spore_color",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses spore print codes into an interpretable color-salience axis, reducing reliance on individual one-hot terms.",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((spore_print_color == 'k') | (spore_print_color == 'n'), 0.0, np.where((spore_print_color == 'b') | (spore_print_color == 'o') | (spore_print_color == 'u') | (spore_print_color == 'y'), 0.35, np.where(spore_print_color == 'w', 0.75, 1.0)))"

    {
      "name": "gill_compaction_score",

      "description": "Weighted narrow-and-crowded gill geometry score using gill size and gill spacing.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "gill_geometry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes two gill geometry fields into a continuous compaction measure that can receive one SVM weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.55 * np.where(gill_size == 'n', 1.0, 0.0) + 0.45 * np.where(gill_spacing == 'c', 1.0, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "gill_color_salience_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal salience of gill hue, with white, red, or yellow low, pink or purple moderate, brown or gray high, and buff, black, chocolate, green, orange, or other codes maximal.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "gill_color",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an ordered hue-intensity projection for gill color, useful as a smooth linear cue.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((gill_color == 'w') | (gill_color == 'e') | (gill_color == 'y'), 0.0, np.where((gill_color == 'p') | (gill_color == 'u'), 0.35, np.where((gill_color == 'n') | (gill_color == 'g'), 0.7, 1.0)))"
